summary.en: Dilution-based feature filtering, alignment across imaging datasets, and retention-time drift in LC–MS classification.
summary.zh: 稀释序列特征筛选、成像质谱数据对齐与 LC–MS 分类的保留时间漂移。

en: Three methods address different sources of variation in mass spectrometry: response to concentration, shifts along the mass axis, and shifts along the retention-time axis.
zh: 本期三篇方法论文分别处理质谱分析中的浓度响应、质量轴偏移和保留时间漂移。

papers.title: Aletheia: an open-source pipeline for QC dilution-based feature filtering in untargeted LC–MS metabolomics and lipidomics

commentary.en: Aletheia uses pooled-QC dilution series to filter LC–MS features and records the reason for each retention, rejection, or flag. In synthetic plasma, it rejected features that had already passed a repeatability filter, showing that the two checks address different properties. A positive slope from two points does not establish linearity, and some negative responses were retained with a flag.
commentary.zh: Aletheia 用混合 QC 稀释系列筛查 LC–MS 特征，并记录各特征的处理原因。合成血浆应用显示，部分重复性达标的特征仍未通过稀释筛查。两个点呈正斜率不证明线性；部分负响应仅标记、未剔除。

papers.title: PGAlign: Peak Group Alignment of Mass Spectrometry Data

commentary.en: PGAlign matches local peak groups rather than isolated peaks to map MALDI imaging datasets onto a shared m/z grid for joint analysis across tissue sections. Companion scripts demonstrate imposed m/z shifts in pancreas data and pixel classification within tissue pairs. The latter does not hold out specimens and therefore does not establish cross-specimen generalization.
commentary.zh: PGAlign 以局部峰群而非孤立峰为单位匹配，将不同 MALDI 成像数据映射到同一 m/z 网格，便于跨切片联合分析。配套脚本展示了胰腺数据中人为施加的 m/z 偏移和配对组织内的像素分类；后者没有按标本留出，不能据此判断跨样本泛化。

papers.title: DEPI-MS: Density-Equalized Pseudo-Image Learning for Drift-Tolerant LC–MS Metabolomics Classification

commentary.en: DEPI-MS represents LC–MS signals as pseudo-images with uniform retention-time bins and m/z resolution allocated by signal density in QC samples. Training applies differentiable retention-time warping. The indexed abstract describes an external nasopharyngeal carcinoma serum validation set and a drift stress test, but does not establish transfer to other instruments or acquisition conditions.
commentary.zh: DEPI-MS 把 LC–MS 信号表示成伪图像，在保留时间轴上等距分箱，在 m/z 轴按 QC 样本的信号密度分配分辨率，并在训练时施加可微的保留时间形变。公开摘要报告了一个外部鼻咽癌血清验证集和漂移压力测试，但无法从摘要判断能否推广到其他仪器或采集条件。
